justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces present a vertically oriented, frontal anthropomorphic form with a head/upper part over a torso-like area, circular motifs on or near the central body, and some horizontal banding. The biggest difference is that A shows a highly elaborate full standing figure with headdress, limbs, ornaments, and surrounding complex motifs, while B is a much more abstract torso-like figure with simple discs and bands and lacks the same detailed attributes or narrative/iconographic components.
